rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policy (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_media.media_asset table, then drops the media_asset table and the northstar_media schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. No media bytes live in this schema (only validated metadata + accessible-alternative records), so the object store is unaffected by a rollback.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_media schema with the media_asset table exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped media table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC
